'''Fang Shouxian''' ({{zh|s=方守贤}}; October 28, 1932 – January 19, 2020) was a Chinese physicist who served as President of the [[Institute of High Energy Physics]], [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS).<ref>{{cite news |author1=Zhong Yuhao ({{lang|zh|钟煜豪}}) |date=19 January 2020 |title= |script-title=zh:蒋洪德、池志强、方守贤，2020年已有3名院士逝去 |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_5567632 |accessdate=22 January 2020 |work=[[The Paper (newspaper)|The Paper]] |language=zh}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2020/1/434975.shtm |script-title=zh:著名加速器物理学家方守贤院士逝世 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=19 January 2020 |accessdate=22 January 2020 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Fang was born in [[Shanghai]], [[Republic of China (1912-1949)|Republic of China]], on October 28, 1932. After graduating from [[Fudan University]] in October 1955, he was assigned to the Institute of Modern Physics, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS). He worked in the [[Soviet Union]] between 1957 and 1960. After returning to China, he was again assigned to the Institute of Modern Physics. He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] on June 22, 1979. He served as vice-president of the [[Institute of High Energy Physics]] in 1986, and two years later was promoted to President. He died of illness in Beijing, on January 19, 2020.<ref>{{cite news|author1=Zhang Hang ({{lang|zh|张航}})|url=http://finance.sina.com.cn/wm/2020-01-19/doc-iihnzhha3519954.shtml |script-title=zh:泪别院士！记者独家探访方守贤的简朴办公室 |work=sina |date=19 January 2020 |accessdate=22 January 2020 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honors and awards==
